localization_policy.deletion_anchor: next semantic nonblank cell on the original physical line; otherwise previous semantic cell on that line
localization_policy.identical_insertions: accept any cell in the same intact physically contiguous identical-cell run only with one exact matching provenance cell and box
localization_policy.identical_deletions: accept an anchor in the shortened same-line identical run or its immediate semantic successor only when the expected run is shortened by exactly one cell
